# Imbalance fade test on Binance BTCUSDT perp (generated by imb.py backtest --k 3.0)

Events on 30m/1h/4h/12h/1d bars resampled from Binance USD-M 1m klines. imb_small = relative volume >= 3.0 and body <= 30% of range (Qriptal's trapped-traders candle); imb_large = relative volume >= 3.0 and body >= 70% (his 'sign of strength', the fade should fail); normal_small = relative volume < 1.2 and body <= 30% (control: same shape, no volume anomaly).
Side: long when the candle makes a new 20-bar low, short at a new 20-bar high. Entry next bar open (1m open); stop = the candle's own low (long) / high (short); target R x risk; time exit after 24 bars; stop first when stop and target share a minute; taker 0.05% per side on both legs.
far_before_stop = share of events where price reached the candle's other extreme (the 'recovery') before the stop. CI95 = day-block bootstrap of mean net R, seed 12345.
Design 2022-01-01..2025-09-01, check 2025-09-01..2026-06-26 (BACKTEST_PROTOCOL DEV). Holdout 2026-06-26.. not read. Pre-stated PASS: imb_small net CI95 low > 0 in design AND check, and above normal_small in both.
